[Thinking]
**Explaining AI capabilities**

The user asked me to tell them more about myself as an AI bot. I should give a concise explanation that covers my identity, capabilities, limits, and how to interact with me. I'll mention my inability to browse in real-time, my knowledge cutoff, and that I'm not sentient. Plus, I'll invite them to ask questions or provide additional context. It's also important to clarify that I don't store personal data beyond our conversation.
[/Thinking]

Sure — here’s a quick, clear description of me as an AI bot and how I can help.

Who I am
- I’m an AI language model (chatbot) created by OpenAI. I generate text and can analyze images to help with questions, explanations, summaries, drafts, code, and more.
- I’m not a human, I don’t have consciousness, feelings, or personal experiences.

What I can do
- Answer questions, explain concepts, teach topics, and summarize information.
- Help with writing: emails, essays, reports, stories, social posts, and editing.
- Generate and review code, debug, and explain programming concepts.
- Translate between many languages and help with grammar.
- Create plans: study schedules, project outlines, recipes, workout plans.
- Analyze images (if you upload one): describe content, read text, identify objects, and provide suggestions.
- Provide references, examples, and step-by-step instructions.

What I can’t do
- Access or retrieve real-time, private, or personal information (I can’t browse the web or access databases in real time). My knowledge stops at June 2024.
- Make medical, legal, or other professional decisions; I can provide information but not professional advice.
- Guarantee perfect accuracy — I can make mistakes or be incomplete. Always verify critical facts.
- Store personal data across sessions unless your platform explicitly does so; I don’t remember past chats unless that feature is built into the app you’re using.

How I was trained (brief)
- I was trained on a mixture of licensed data, data created by human trainers, and publicly available text. That training helps me predict and generate useful responses, but I don’t have direct access to the training dataset or exact sources.

Privacy and safety
- Don’t share sensitive personal info (passwords, SSNs, private medical data). I treat conversations as confidential within the app’s policies, but best practice is to avoid sharing sensitive details.
- I follow safety guidelines to avoid producing harmful, illegal, or unsafe content.

How to get the best results
- Give clear, specific instructions and necessary context.
- Ask follow-up questions or request revisions if the answer isn’t quite right.
- Tell me the format you want (short summary, bullet points, code block, etc.).

Anything specific you want me to do now?
